reason: DEC A ($3A) is a real 65SC12 opcode (2 cycles); nothing else new. sky_row: removed EOR #(2) SEC(2) ADC #(2) LDA zp(3) = 9 cycles and 7 bytes, added DEC A(2) EOR #(2) = 4 cycles and 3 bytes: 5 cycles saved on every call, 4 bytes shorter, padded back with SKIP 4 after the RTS so sky_draw stays at &30A3 (old sky_row &3083-&30A2 is 32 bytes, new 28+4). sky_rn is always 1-8 (sky_geom: bottom row sky_L+1 with sky_L = A AND 7; the others 8, or 1-8 left over since sky_H from sky_heights is 23-28; the split entry copies an existing row's rn), so (n-1) EOR 7 = 8-n. Exit Z/N come from the EOR, same byte as the old LDA sky_skip; C and V differ but no caller reads them: sky_draw's part path ASLs (sets C) and its whole path ends in CPX; sky_zero and sky_check (sky.6502) do LDX/LDA/ORA/TAX/BNE/BRA and SEC before any SBC. Y = sky_rt,X OR sky_ry,X, the same abs,X reads at the same indexes, only earlier. CLC hoist: .row entered first after LDX #0 (C cleared just before), later from JMP row after CPX sky_nq / BEQ done not taken with X < sky_nq, so C=0; STX, LDA abs,X, LDY, BEQ, ORA, TAY, LDA abs,Y leave C, so ADC sky_j8 sees C=0. Per sky_draw: -2 per row, +2 once. In sky_draw only .row..the old CLC moves (+1 byte, &30AB-ish), short BEQ h0 inside it, JMP row absolute; .cell &3101, line8 &3104 (the self-modified JMP's target arithmetic: LO/HI(line8), cell+1/+2) and .next_row stay put, so no page crossing or branch range changes. No code reads sky_row as data or writes into it.
